issues.description: Method conflict for Milkable.messageOnMilk: the problem statement UML and textual description require a no-argument method messageOnMilk() that returns a String like "[Animal Type] [name] is milked" (see problem_statement.md). The template Main.java calls messageOnMilk() with no arguments. The solution repository, however, defines the interface as messageOnMilk(double volume) and the Seal/Goat implementations implement messageOnMilk(double) and return strings that include the volume (e.g. "Goat X is milked (2.0L)"). This parameter-list mismatch (no-arg vs. one double parameter) will cause compilation errors or API incompatibility for students following the problem/template or for tests expecting the no-arg signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Milkable API consistent across all artifacts. Preferred fix to preserve the current problem statement and template: change the solution to declare String messageOnMilk() (no parameters) in Milkable.java and update Seal and Goat to implement messageOnMilk() returning "[Animal Type] [name] is milked" (matching the textual requirement). Alternatively, if volume is intentionally required, update problem_statement.md (UML and textual description), the template Main usage, and the tests to require messageOnMilk(double volume) and document the expected return format (e.g. "[Animal Type] [name] is milked ([volume]L)"). Ensure template code, examples, and tests all use the same signature.
